verses.he: וַאֲמַר יְיָ לְמשֶׁה אֱמַר לְכַהֲנַיָּא בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן עַל מִית לָא יִסְתָּאַב בְּעַמֵּיהּ:
verses.en: Adonoy said to Moshe; speak, to the kohanim, the sons of Aharon, and you shall say to them, let him not defile himself with the dead among his people.

verses.he: אֶלָּהֵן לְקָרִיבֵיהּ דְּקָרִיב לֵיהּ לְאִמֵּיהּ וְלַאֲבוּהִי וְלִבְרֵיהּ וְלִבְרַתֵּיהּ וְלַאֲחוּהִי:
verses.en: Except to his kin to whom he is closely related, for his mother and his father, for his son, his daughter and for his brother.

verses.he: וְלַאֲחָתֵיהּ בְּתֻלְתָּא דְּקָרִיבָא לֵיהּ דִּי לָא הֲוַת לִגְבָר לַהּ יִסְתָּאָב:
verses.en: For his virgin sister, to whom he is closely related, who has not yet been married, for her, he may be defiled.

verses.he: לָא יִסְתָּאַב רַבָּא בְעַמֵּיהּ לְאַחֲלוּתֵיהּ:
verses.en: A husband [An honored one among his people] may not defile himself among his people [for a wife through whom] he becomes profaned.

verses.he: לָא יִמְרְטוּן מְרַט בְּרֵישְׁהוֹן וּפָאתָא דְדִקְנְהוֹן לָא יְגַלְּחוּן וּבְבִשְׂרְהוֹן לָא יְחַבְּלוּן חִבּוּל:
verses.en: They shall not make baldness on their heads and the corners of their beards they shall not shave, and they shall not make gashes in their flesh.

verses.he: קַדִּישִׁין יְהוֹן קֳדָם אֱלָהֲהוֹן וְלָא יְחַלּוּן שְׁמָא דֶּאֱלָהֲהוֹן אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבְּנַיָּא דַיְיָ קֻרְבָּן אֱלָהֲהוֹן אִנּוּן מַקְרִיבִין וִיהוֹן קַדִּישִׁין:
verses.en: They shall be holy to [before] their God and they shall not profane the Name of their God, for [it is] the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy, the bread [sacrifice] of their God [that] they bring [offer], and they must [therefore] be holy.

verses.he: אִתְּתָא מַטְעֲיָא וּמְחַלְּלָא לָא יִסְּבוּן וְאִתְּתָא דִּמְתָרְכָא מִבַּעְלַהּ לָא יִסְּבוּן אֲרֵי קַדִּישׁ הוּא קֳדָם אֱלָהֵיהּ:
verses.en: A harlot [One who strays] or a profaned woman they shall not marry. A woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry, for he is holy to [before] his God.

verses.he: וּתְקַדְּשִׁנֵּיהּ אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהָךְ הוּא מְקָרֵב קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לָךְ אֲרֵי קַדִּישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall make him holy for he offers the bread [sacrifice] of your God; he shall be holy unto you for I, Adonoy, am holy, Who makes you holy.

verses.he: וּבַת גְּבַר כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תִתְחַל לְמִטְעֵי מִקְּדֻשַּׁת אֲבוּהָ הִיא מִתַּחֲלָא בְּנוּרָא תִּתּוֹקָד:
verses.en: The daughter of a kohein, who profanes herself by fornication [straying]—she profanes her father—[she becomes profane with respect to her father’s holiness] she shall be burned with fire.

verses.he: וְכַהֲנָא דְאִתְרַבָּא מֵאֲחוֹהִי דְּ יִתָּרִיק עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ מִשְׁחָא דִרְבוּתָא וְדִי קָרִיב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ לְמִלְבַּשׁ יָת לְבוּשַׁיָּא יָת רֵישֵׁיהּ לָא יְרַבֵּי פֵרוּעַ וּלְבוּשׁוֹהִי לָא יִבְזַע:
verses.en: The kohein who is greatest among his brethren upon whose head was poured the anointing oil [which inaugurates to greatness]; whose hands [sacrifices] were consecrated [offered] to put on the special garments; shall not let his hair grow wild and he shall not tear his garments.

verses.he: וְעַל כָּל נַפְשַׁת מֵתָא לָא יֵיעוֹל לַאֲבוּהִי וּלְאִמֵּיהּ לָא יִסְתָּאָב:
verses.en: And adjacent to any dead body he shall not enter. For his father and mother he shall not become [ritually] impure.

verses.he: וּמִין מַקְדְּשָׁא לָא יִפּוֹק וְלָא יַחֵל יָת מַקְדְּשָׁא דֶאֱלָהֵיהּ אֲרֵי כְּלִיל מְשַׁח רְבוּתָא דֶאֱלָהֵיהּ עֲלוֹהִי אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: He shall not depart from the Sanctuary and he shall not profane his Gods Sanctuary, for the crown of his Gods anointing oil [which inaugurates to greatness] is upon him, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְהוּא אִתְּתָא בִּבְתֻלְתָּהָא יִסָּב:
verses.en: He shall marry [only] a virgin.

verses.he: אַרְמְלָא וּמְתָרְכָא וְחַלִּילָא מַטְעֲיָא יָת אִלֵּין לָא יִסָּב אֱלָהֵן בְּתֻלְתָּא מֵעַמֵּיהּ יִסַּב אִתְּתָא:
verses.en: A widow, divorcee, profaned woman or harlot [one who strays]; he may not marry [any] of these. But only a virgin from his own people may he marry.

verses.he: וְלָא יַחֵל זַרְעֵיהּ בְּעַמֵּיהּ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדְּשֵׁיהּ:
verses.en: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Adonoy, who makes him holy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּל עִם אַהֲרֹן לְמֵימָר גְּבַר מִבְּנָיךְ לְדָרֵיהוֹן דִּי יְהֵי בֵיהּ מוּמָא לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם אֱלָהֵיהּ:
verses.en: Speak to Aharon saying; Anyone of your offspring, through [all] their generations who will have a blemish, shall not approach to offer the bread [sacrifice] of [before] his God.

verses.he: אֲרֵי כָל גְּבַר דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא לָא יִקְרָב גְּבַר עַוִּיר אוֹ חֲגִיר אוֹ חָרִים אוֹ שְׂרִיעַ:
verses.en: For any man who has a blemish shall not approach; a blind man or a lame man, or a man with a sunken nose, or a man who has disproportionate limbs.

verses.he: אוֹ גְבַר דִּי יְהֵי בֵיהּ תְּבַר רַגְלָא אוֹ תְּבַר יְדָא:
verses.en: or a man who has a broken (crippled) foot, or a broken (crippled) hand,

verses.he: אוֹ גְבִין אוֹ דֻקָּא אוֹ חִלִּיז בְּעֵינֵיהּ אוֹ גַרְבָן אוֹ חֲזָזָן אוֹ מְרַס פַּחֲדִין:
verses.en: or one with overhanging eyebrows, or with a cataract, or a disarrangement [in the eye], or one with scurf or scabs, or one with crushed testicles.

verses.he: כָּל גְּבַר דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא מִזַּרְעָא דְּאַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא יָת קֻרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ מוּמָא בֵיהּ יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֵיהּ לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא:
verses.en: Any man who has a blemish, who is a descendant of Aharon the kohein, shall not approach to offer the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy. He has a blemish; the bread [sacrifice] of his God he may not approach to offer [as an offering].

verses.he: קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֵיהּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ קוּדְשַׁיָּא וּמִן קוּדְשַׁיָּא יֵיכוּל:
verses.en: The bread of his God which is of the most holy, and from the holy [offerings] he may eat.

verses.he: בְּרַם לְפָרֻכְתָּא לָא יֵיעוֹל וּלְמַדְבְּחָא לָא יִקְרַב אֲרֵי מוּמָא בֵיהּ וְלָא יַחֵל יָת מַקְדְּשַׁי אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁהוֹן:
verses.en: However, he may not enter beyond the Curtain and he shall not approach the Altar for he has a blemish and he shall not profane My holy things, for I am Adonoy, who sanctifies them.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל משֶׁה עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְעִם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
verses.en: Moshe spoke [these words] to Aharon, and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְיִפָּרְשׁוּן מִקּוּדְשַׁיָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָא יְחַלּוּן יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשִׁי דִּי אִנּוּן מְקַדְּשִׁין קֳדָמַי אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and let them keep away from the holy offerings of Bnei Yisroel and they shall not profane My holy name which they sanctify for [before] Me, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: אֱמַר לְהוֹן לְדָרֵיכוֹן כָּל גְּבַר דִּי יִקְרַב מִכָּל בְּנֵיכוֹן לְקוּדְשַׁיָּא דִּי יְקַדְּשׁוּן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם יְיָ וְסֹאבְתֵיהּ עֲלוֹהִי וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי אֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא מִן קֳדָמַי אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: Say to them; throughout your generations; any person of your offspring who will draw near to the holy things which Bnei Yisroel will sanctify to [before] Adonoy [while] his impurity is on him that soul [person] shall be cut off from My Presence, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: גְּבַר גְּבַר מִזַּרְעָא דְאַהֲרֹן וְהוּא סְגִיר אוֹ דָאִיב בְּקוּדְשַׁיָּא לָא יֵיכוּל עַד דִּי יִדְכֵּי וּדְיִקְרַב בְּכָל טְמֵא נַפְשָׁא אוֹ גְבַר דִּי תִפּוֹק מִנֵּיהּ שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא:
verses.en: Any man of Aharons offspring; who has tzoraas [the plague of ’confinement’] or an impure flow, may not eat of the sacred things until he has purified himself. [The same is true] of anyone who touches anything defiled by the dead [soul], or anyone who has had a seminal emission,

verses.he: אוֹ גְבַר דִּי יִקְרַב בְּכָל רִחֲשָׁא דִּי יִסְתָּאַב לֵיהּ אוֹ בַאֲנָשָׁא דִּי יִסְתָּאַב לֵיהּ לְכֹל סֹאבְתֵיהּ:
verses.en: or anyone who touches any creeping creature that causes impurity to him, or any person which causes impurity to him, [with] whatever impurity he has.

verses.he: אֱנַשׁ דִּי יִקְרַב בֵּיהּ וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא וְלָא יֵיכוּל מִן קוּדְשַׁיָּא אֱלָהֵן אַסְחֵי בִשְׂרֵיהּ בְּמַיָּא:
verses.en: Anyone touching [that person] will be impure until the evening. He shall not eat of the holy things unless he has washed his body in water.

verses.he: וּבְמֵעַל שִׁמְשָׁא וְיִדְכֵּי וּבָתַר כֵּן יֵיכוּל מִן קוּדְשַׁיָּא אֲרֵי לַחְמֵיהּ הוּא:
verses.en: When the sun sets, he is pure, and afterwards, he may eat of the holy things, for it is his bread.

verses.he: נְבִילָא וּתְבִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בַהּ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: An animal which has died on its own, or an animal that was fatally maimed, he must not eat to defile himself with it, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְיִטְּרוּן יָת מַטְּרַת מֵימְרִי וְלָא יְקַבְּלוּן עֲלוֹהִי חוֹבָא וִימוּתוּן בֵּיהּ אֲרֵי יְחַלֻּנֵּיהּ אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁהוֹן:
verses.en: They shall keep my charge [the charge of My Word] lest they bear [the burden] of sin and die because of it for having profaned [it]. I am Adonoy Who makes them holy.

verses.he: וְכָל חִלּוֹנַי לָא יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא תּוֹתָבָא דְכַהֲנָא וַאֲגִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא:
verses.en: No stranger (non-kohein) may eat holy things. One indentured to a kohein and one hired [by a kohein] may not eat sacred-offerings.

verses.he: וְכָהֵן אֲרֵי יִקְנֵי נְפַשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפֵּיהּ הוּא יֵיכוּל בֵּיהּ וִילִיד בֵּיתֵיהּ אִנּוּן יֵיכְלוּן בְּלַחְמֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a kohein shall purchase a person [as a slave, that person is] his monetary possession. He may eat of it, and the [slave] born in his house, they may eat of his bread.

verses.he: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהֵי לִגְבַר חִלּוֹנָי הִיא בְּאַפְרָשׁוּת קוּדְשַׁיָּא לָא תֵיכוּל:
verses.en: When a koheins daughter marries a non-kohein, the sacred terumah [separated] portions may not be eaten by her.

verses.he: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהֵי אַרְמְלָא וּמְתָרְכָא וּבַר לֵית לַהּ וּתְתוּב לְבֵית אֲבוּהָא כְּרַבְיוּתָהָא מִלַּחְמָא דַאֲבוּהָא תֵּיכוּל וְכָל חִלּוֹנַי לָא יֵיכוּל בֵּיהּ:
verses.en: If a koheins daughter is either widowed or divorced, and she has no children, and she returns to her fathers home as in her youth, she may eat of her fathers bread. No non-kohein may eat of it.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא בְּשָׁלוּ וְיוֹסֵף חוּמְשֵׁיהּ עֲלוֹהִי וִיתֵּן לְכַהֲנָא יָת קוּדְשָׁא:
verses.en: If a man inadvertently eats of sacred-offering, he shall add a fifth, to it[s worth] and give to the kohein the holy thing.

verses.he: וְלָא יְחַלּוּן יָת קוּדְשַׁיָּא דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת דִּי יַפְרְשׁוּן קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: They shall not profane the holy things of Bnei Yisroel that which they designated for [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וִיקַבְּלוּן עֲלֵיהוֹן עֲוָיָן וְחוֹבִין בְּמֵיכָלְהוֹן בְּסוֹאַבָא יָת קוּדְשֵׁיהוֹן אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁהוֹן:
verses.en: They burden them[selves] with the sin of their guilt when they eat their holy things [in impurity], for I am Adonoy, Who makes them holy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְעִם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן גְּבַר גְּבַר מִבֵּית יִשָׂרָאֵל וּמִן גִּיּוֹרָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי יְקָרֵב קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ לְכָל נִדְרֵיהוֹן וּלְכָל נִדְבַתְהוֹן דִּי יְקָרְבוּן קֳדָם יְיָ לַעֲלָתָא:
verses.en: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel and say to them; any man of the House of Israel, and from the proselytes of Israel who will bring his offering for any of their vows or for any of their free-will-offerings that they will bring to [before] Adonoy, for a burnt-offering.

verses.he: לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן שְׁלִים דְּכוּרָא בְּתוֹרֵי בְּאִמְרַיָּא וּבְעִזַּיָּא:
verses.en: To gain acceptance [it must be] an unblemished male of cattle, sheep or goats.

verses.he: כֹּל דִּי בֵיהּ מוּמָא לָא תְקָרְבוּן אֲרֵי לָא לְרַעֲוָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן:
verses.en: Anything that has a blemish on it you shall not bring, for it will not be accepted favorably for you.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יְקָרֵב נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ לְפָרָשָׁא נִדְרָא אוֹ לִנְדַבְתָּא בְּתוֹרֵי אוֹ בְעָנָא שְׁלִים יְהֵי לְרַעֲוָא כָּל מוּמָא לָא יְהֵי בֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a man will bring a peace[sacred]-offering to [before] Adonoy, to fulfill an articulated vow or free-will-offering of cattle or of sheep, it shall be unblemished, that it be favorably accepted. No blemish shall be in it.

verses.he: עַוִּיר אוֹ תְבִיר אוֹ פְסִיק אוֹ יַבְּלָן אוֹ גַרְבָן אוֹ חֲזָזָן לָא תְקָרְבוּן אִלֵּין קֳדָם יְיָ וְקֻרְבָּנָא לָא תִתְּנוּן מִנְּהוֹן עַל מַדְבְּחָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: A blind, broken-limbed, cracked or wart[ed animal]; or [an animal] with scurf or scabs you shall not bring these to [before] Adonoy; and as a fire-offering [an offering] you shall not place of them on the altar of [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְתוֹר וְאִמַּר יַתִּיר וְחַסִּיר נְדַבְתָּא תַּעְבֵּד יָתֵיהּ וּלְנִדְרָא לָא יְהֵי לְרַעֲוָא:
verses.en: An ox or lamb with one limb larger [or smaller] than the other or with uncleft hooves [one limb smaller than the other], you shall make (offer) it as a free-will-offering [to the temple treasury] [but] for [the fulfillment of] a vow it will not be favorably accepted.

verses.he: וְדִי מְרִיס וְדִי רְסִיס וְדִי שְׁלִיף וְדִי גְזִיר לָא תְקָרְבוּן קֳדָם יְיָ וּבְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן:
verses.en: [An animal that has its testicles] crushed, mangled, torn or cut off you shall not bring to [before] Adonoy and in your land you shall not inflict these injuries.

verses.he: וּמִן בַּר עַמְמִין לָא תְקָרְבוּן יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהָכוֹן מִכָּל אִלֵּין אֲרֵי חִבּוּלְהוֹן בְּהוֹן מוּמָא בְהוֹן לָא לְרַעֲוָא יְהוֹן לְכוֹן:
verses.en: And from a strangers [gentiles] hand you shall not bring (offer) the bread [offering] of your God from any of these for they have inflicted wounds in them; they will not be favorably accepted for you.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: תּוֹר אוֹ אִמָּר אוֹ עִזָּא אֲרֵי יִתְיְלִיד וִיהֵי שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין בָּתַר אִמֵּיהּ וּמִיּוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה וּלְהַלָּא יִתִּרְעֵי לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: An ox, lamb or goat, when it is born, shall be with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day and thereafter it may be favorably accepted as a sacrifice as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְתוֹרְתָּא אוֹ שֵׂיתָא לַהּ וְלִבְרַהּ לָא תִכְּסוּן בְּיוֹמָא חָד:
verses.en: An ox [cow] or a [female] lamb, it and its [her and her] offspring, you shall not slaughter in one day.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תִכְּסוּן נִכְסַת תּוֹדְתָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן תִּכְּסֻנֵּיהּ:
verses.en: When you sacrifice a thanks-giving-offering to [before] Adonoy, that it be favorably accepted for you you shall sacrifice it.

verses.he: בְּיוֹמָא הַהוּא יִתְאֲכֵל לָא תַשְׁאֲרוּן מִנֵּיהּ עַד צַפְרָא אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: On that day [that it is sacrificed] you should eat it; you shall leave none of it until the next morning, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְתִטְּרוּן פִּקּוֹדַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall preserve My commandments and fulfill them, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְלָא תְחַלְּלוּן יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשַׁי וְאִתְקַדַּשׁ בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not profane My holy Name; but I will be sanctified among Bnei Yisroel. I am Adonoy Who makes you holy.

verses.he: דְּאַפִּיק יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְמֶהֱוֵי לְכוֹן לֵאלָהָא אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׁרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן מוֹעֲדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי תְעָרְעוּן יָתְהוֹן מְעָרְעֵי קַדִּישׁ אִלֵּין אִנּוּן מוֹעֲדָי:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them; the appointed times of Adonoy, which you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] as holy assemblies [occurrences]; these are My appointed times.

verses.he: שִׁתָּא יוֹמִין תִּתְעֲבֵד עִבִידָא וּבְיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה שְׁבַת שְׁבָתָא מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ כָּל עִבִידָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן שַׁבְּתָא הִיא קֳדָם יְיָ בְּכֹל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: Six days shall work be performed; and on the seventh day is a Shabbos of resting, a holy assembly [occurrence]. You shall not do any work, it is a Shabbos for [before] Adonoy in all your dwelling places.

verses.he: אִלֵּין מוֹעֲדַיָּא דַיְיָ מְעָרְעֵי קַדִּישׁ דִּי תְעָרְעוּן יָתְהוֹן בְּזִמְנֵיהוֹן:
verses.en: These are the appointed times of Adonoy, the holy assemblies [occurrences] that you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] in their appointed times.

verses.he: בְּיַרְחָא קַדְמָאָה בְּאַרְבְּעַת עַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא בֵּין שִׁמְשַׁיָּא פִּסְחָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: In the first month (Nisan), on the fourteenth day of the month in the afternoon, is a Pesach (offering) for [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּבְחַמְשַׁת עַשְׂרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא הָדֵין חַגָּא דְּפַטִּירַיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין פַּטִּיר תֵּיכְלוּן:
verses.en: On the fifteenth day of this month is the festival of matzos, for [before] Adonoy; for seven days you shall eat matzos [matzoh].

verses.he: בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יִהֵי לְכוֹן כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחַן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן:
verses.en: On the first day [there] shall be a day of holy assembly [occurrence] for you; you shall not do any work of labor.

verses.he: וּתְקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחָן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן:
verses.en: You shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy [on each of] seven days. On the seventh day it is [a day] of holy assembly [occurrence]; you shall not do any work of labor.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying,

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן אֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא דִּי אֲנָא יָהֵב לְכוֹן וְתַחְצְדוּן יָת חֲצָדַהּ וְתַיְתוּן יָת עוּמְרָא רֵישׁ חֲצָדְכוֹן לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them; when you come into the land that I give to you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring an omer of the first fruits of your harvest to the kohein.

verses.he: וִירִים יָת עוּמְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן מִבָּתַר יוֹמָא טָבָא יְרִימִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: He shall wave [lift up] the omer before Adonoy that it be favorably accepted for you. On the day after the day of rest (Pesach), the kohein shall wave [lift] it [up].

verses.he: וְתַעְבְּדוּן בְּיוֹמָא דַאֲרָמוּתְכוֹן יָת עוּמְרָא אִמַּר שְׁלִים בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall prepare, on the day when you wave [lift] the omer, an unblemished, male, yearling lamb as a burnt-offering, to [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמִנְחָתֵיהּ תְּרֵין עֶשְׁרוֹנִין סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְאִתְקַבָּלָא בְרַעֲוָא וְנִסְכֵּיהּ חַמְרָא רַבְעוּת הִינָא:
verses.en: Its meal-offering is two tenths of flour mixed with [olive] oil as a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy of pleasing fragrance [to be accepted with favor]. Its wine-offering is one fourth of a hin.

verses.he: וּלְחֵם וּקְלִי וּפֵרוּכָן לָא תֵיכְלוּן עַד כְּרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין עַד אַיְתוֹאֵיכוֹן יָת קֻרְבָּן אֱלָהָכוֹן קְיַם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן בְּכֹל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: Bread, parched grain or tender [ground] grain you shall not eat until this very day, until you bring the offering of your God; it is an everlasting statute for all your generations in all your dwelling places.

verses.he: וְתִמְנוּן לְכוֹן מִבָּתַר יוֹמָא טָבָא מִיּוֹם אַיְתוֹאֵיכוֹן יָת עוּמְרָא דַאֲרָמוּתָא שִׁבְעָא שָׁבוּעִין שַׁלְמִין יְהֶוְיָן:
verses.en: You shall count for yourselves, from the day after the day of rest (Pesach) from the day on which you will bring the omer waveuplifted-offering, seven complete weeks they shall be,

verses.he: עַד מִבָּתַר שְׁבוּעֲתָא שְׁבִיעֵתָא תִּמְנוּן חַמְשִׁין יוֹמִין וּתְקָרְבוּן מִנְחָתָא חֲדַתָּא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: Until the day after the seventh week, you shall count fifty days, and you shall bring a new meal-offering to [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: מִמּוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן תַּיְתוּן לְחֵם אֲרָמוּתָא תַּרְתֵּין (גְּרִיצַן) תְּרֵין עֶשְׁרוֹנִין סֻלְתָּא יְהֶוְיָן חֲמִיעַ יִתְאַפְיָן בִּכּוּרִין קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: From [the land of] your dwelling places you shall bring two bread wave[uplifted]-offerings; of two tenths of flour they shall be. You shall bake them leavened, as first-fruit-offering to [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּתְקָרְבוּן עַל לַחְמָא שִׁבְעָא אִמְּרִין שַׁלְמִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא וְתוֹר בַּר תּוֹרֵי חַד וְדִכְרִין תְּרֵין יְהוֹן עֲלָתָא קֳדָם יְיָ וּמִנְחָתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן קֻרְבַּן דְּמִתְקַבֵּל בְּרַעֲוָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall bring, along with the bread, seven unblemished, yearling lambs, one young bullock and two rams; they shall be a burnt-offering to [before] Adonoy with their meal-offerings and wine-offerings, a fire-offering of pleasing fragrance to [an offering which is accepted with favor before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְתַעְבְּדוּן צְפִיר בַּר עִזֵּי חַד לְחַטָּאתָא וּתְרֵין אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא לְנִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא:
verses.en: You shall prepare one he-goat as a sin-offering and two yearling lambs as peace[sacred]-offerings.

verses.he: וִירִים כַּהֲנָא יָתְהוֹן עַל לְחֵם בִּכּוּרַיָּא אֲרָמוּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ עַל תְּרֵין אִמְּרִין קוּדְשָׁא יְהוֹן קֳדָם יְיָ לְכַהֲנָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall wave [lift] them [up] along with the bread of the first-fruit-offering as a wave-offering [an uplifted-offering] before Adonoy with the two lambs; they shall be holy for [before] Adonoy, for the kohein.

verses.he: וּתְעָרְעוּן בִּכְרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחָן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן קְיַם עָלָם בְּכָל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן לְדָרֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall proclaim [cause to occur] on this very day; it shall be a [day of] holy assembly [occurrence] for you you shall not do any work of labor. It is an everlasting statute in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.

verses.he: וּבְמֶחֱצָדְכוֹן יָת חֲצָדָא דְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תְשֵׁיצֵי פָּאתָא דְחַקְלָךְ בְּמֶחֱצָדָךְ וּלְקָטָא דַחֲצָדָךְ לָא תְלַקֵּט לְעַנְיֵי וּלְגִיּוֹרֵי תִּשְׁבּוֹק יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not cut completely the corner of your field when you reap. You shall not gather the gleaning of your harvest. You shall leave them for the poor and the proselyte, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵימָר בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּחַד לְיַרְחָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן נְיָחָא דּוּכְרַן יַבָּבָא מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying; in the seventh month, on the first of the month, shall be for you a [day of] rest. A remembrance of the sounding [crying] [of the shofor], a holy assembly [occurrence].

verses.he: כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחָנָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן וּתְקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall not do any work of labor and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: בְּרַם בְּעַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה הָדֵין יוֹמָא דְכִפּוּרַיָּא הוּא מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן וּתְעַנּוּן יָת נַפְשָׁתֵיכוֹן וּתְקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: Indeed, on the tenth day of this seventh month is a day of atonement. It shall be for you a [day of] holy assembly [occurrence] and you shall afflict yourselves and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וְכָל עִבִידָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן בִּכְרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין אֲרֵי יוֹמָא דְכִפּוּרַיָּא הוּא לְכַפָּרָא עֲלֵיכוֹן קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not do any work on this very day, for it is a day of atonements, to atone for you before Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: אֲרֵי כָל אֲנָשָׁא דִּי לָא מִתְעַנֵּי בִּכְרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי מֵעַמָּהָא:
verses.en: For any person who will not be afflicted on this very day shall be cut off from his people.

verses.he: וְכָל אֱנַשׁ דִּי תַעְבֵּד כָּל עִבִידָא בִּכְרַן יוֹמָא הָדֵין וְאוֹבֵד יָת אֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא מִגּוֹ עַמַּהּ:
verses.en: Any person who does any work on this very day, I will cause that person to perish from among his people.

verses.he: כָּל עִבִידָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן קְיַם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן בְּכֹל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not do any work; it is an everlasting statute for all your generations in all your dwelling places.

verses.he: שְׁבַת שְׁבָתָא הוּא לְכוֹן וּתְעַנּוּן יָת נַפְשָׁתֵיכוֹן בְּתִישְׁעָא לְיַרְחָא בְּרַמְשָׁא מֵרַמְשָׁא עַד רַמְשָׁא תְּנוּחוּן נְיַחֲכוֹן:
verses.en: It is a Shabbos of complete rest for you and you shall afflict yourselves on the ninth day of the month at evening; from evening to evening you shall rest, on your day of rest.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵימָר בְּחַמְשָׁא עַשְׁרָא יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה הָדֵין חַגָּא דִמְטַלַּיָּא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel saying; on the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the festival of [shelters] Sukkos for seven days, for [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחָן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן:
verses.en: On the first day [there shall be] a holy assembly [occurrence]; you shall not do any work of labor.

verses.he: שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין תְּקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ בְּיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה מְעָרַע קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי לְכוֹן וּתְקָרְבוּן קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ כְּנֵשׁ תְּהוֹן כָּל עִבִידַת פָּלְחָן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן:
verses.en: For seven days, you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy; the eighth day shall be for you a holy assembly [occurrence], and you shall bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy. It is [a day] of convocation. you shall not do any work of labor.

verses.he: אִלֵּין מוֹעֲדַיָּא דַיְיָ דִּי תְעָרְעוּן יָתְהוֹן מְעָרְעֵי קַדִּישׁ לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ עֲלָתָא וּמִנְחָתָא נִכְסַת קוּדְשִׁין וְנִסּוּכִין פִּתְגַם יוֹם בְּיוֹמֵיהּ:
verses.en: These are the appointed times of Adonoy which you shall proclaim [cause] them [to occur] [as] holy assemblies [occurrences], on which to bring a fire-offering to [an offering before] Adonoy; a burnt-offering and a meal-offering, a [sacred-]sacrifice and wine-offerings, each on its assigned day,

verses.he: בַּר שַׁבַּיָּא דַיְיָ וּבַר מַתְּנָתֵיכוֹן וּבַר כָּל נִדְרֵיכוֹן וּבַר כָּל נִדְבָתֵיכוֹן דִּי תִתְּנוּן קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: Besides the [offerings of the] Shabbasos of Adonoy and besides your gifts and besides all your vow-offerings and besides all your free-will-offerings that you will give to [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: בְּרַם בְּחַמְשָׁא עֲשַׁר יוֹמָא לְיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּמִכְנְשֵׁיכוֹן יָת עֲלַלַת אַרְעָא תְּחַגּוּן יָת חַגָּא קֳדָם יְיָ שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה נְיָחָא וּבְיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה נְיָחָא:
verses.en: Indeed, on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather the produce of the land you shall celebrate the festival of [before] Adonoy for seven days. The first day is a day of rest and the eighth day is a day of rest.

verses.he: וְתִסְּבוּן לְכוֹן בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה פֵּרֵי אִילָנָא אֶתְרוֹגִין וְלֻלַּבִּין וַהֲדַסִּין וְעַרְבִין דִּנְחָל וְתֶחֱדוּן קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין:
verses.en: You shall take for yourselves, on the first day, the fruit of the beautiful tree (esrog) [esrogim], a branch of palm trees (lulav) [lulavim], boughs of thick-leaved trees (hadasim), and willows of the brook (aravos), and you shall rejoice before Adonoy, your God, for seven days.

verses.he: וּתְחַגּוּן יָתֵיהּ חַגָּא קֳדָם יְיָ שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין בְּשַׁתָּא קְיַם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה תְּחַגּוּן יָתֵיהּ:
verses.en: You shall celebrate it as a festival to [before] Adonoy seven days in the year; it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations in the seventh month, you shall celebrate it.

verses.he: בִּמְטַלַּיָּא תֵיתְבוּן שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין כָּל יַצִּיבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵתְבוּן בִּמְטַלַּיָּא:
verses.en: You shall dwell in the [shelters] sukkos seven days, every native born [settled] Israelite shall dwell in the [shelters] sukkos.

verses.he: בְּדִיל דִּיִדְּעוּן דָּרֵיכוֹן אֲרֵי בִמְטַלָּיוּת עֲנָנֵי אוֹתֵבִית יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַפָּקוּתִי יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: So that your generations will know that in the [clouds of shelter] sukkos I caused Bnei Yisroel to dwell when I took them out from the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל משֶׁה יָת סְדַר מוֹעֲדַיָּא דַיְיָ וְאַלֵּפִנּוּן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
verses.en: And thus Moshe declared the [order of the] appointed times of Adonoy [and taught them] to Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: פַּקֵּד יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִסְּבוּן לָךְ מְשַׁח זֵיתָא דַכְיָא כָּתִישָׁא לְאַנְהָרָא לְאַדְלָקָא בוֹצִינַיָּא תְּדִירָא:
verses.en: Command Bnei Yisroel to take (bring) to you pure, pressed, olive oil for illumination to keep the lamp [lamps] burning constantly.

verses.he: מִבָּרָא לְפָרֻכְתָּא דְסַהֲדוּתָא בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא יַסְדַּר יָתֵיהּ אֲהֲרֹן מֵרַמְשָׁא עַד צַפְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא קְיָם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: Outside of the Curtain of the Testimony, which is inside the Tent of Meeting, Aharon shall arrange it [so that it burns] from evening until morning before Adonoy, continually; as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

verses.he: עַל מְנַרְתָּא דָכִיתָא יַסְדַּר יָת בּוֹצִינַיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא:
verses.en: Atop the pure menorah he shall arrange the lights before Adonoy, constantly.

verses.he: וְתִסַּב סֻלְתָּא וְתֵיפֵי יָתַהּ תַּרְתָּא עַשְׂרֵי גְּרִיצָן תְּרֵין עֶשְׂרוֹנִין תְּהֵי גְּרִצְתָּא חֲדָא:
verses.en: You shall take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, each individual loaf shall be two tenths [of an ephah].

verses.he: וּתְשַׁוִּי יָתְהוֹן תַּרְתֵּין סִדְרִין שִׁית סִדְרָא עַל פָּתוֹרָא דַכְיָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall place them in two stacks, six in each stack on the Pure Table, before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְתִתֵּן עַל סִדְרָא לְבֻנְתָּא דָכִיתָא וּתְהֵי לִלְחֵם לְאִדְכַּרְתָּא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall put pure frankincense on [each] stack and it shall be as a memorial portion for the bread, as a fire-offering, to [an offering before] Adonoy.

verses.he: בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא יַסְדְּרִנֵּיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא מִן קֳדָם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קְיַם עָלָם:
verses.en: On each and every Shabbos he shall arrange them before Adonoy, continually, from [before] Bnei Yisroel as an eternal covenant.

verses.he: וּתְהֵי לְאַהֲרֹן וְלִבְנוֹהִי וְיֵכְלֻנֵּיהּ בַּאֲתַר קַדִּישׁ אֲרֵי קֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשִׁין הוּא לֵיהּ מִקֻּרְבָּנַיָּא דַיְיָ קְיַם עָלָם:
verses.en: It shall belong to Aharon and to his sons and they shall eat it in a sacred place, for it is most holy for him from among the fire-offerings [offerings] of Adonoy, as an everlasting statute.

verses.he: וּנְפַק בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהוּא בַּר גְּבַר מִצְרָאָה בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְצוֹ בְּמַשְׁרִיתָא בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַבְרָא בַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל:
verses.en: The son of an Israelite woman went out, and he was the son of an Egyptian man, among Bnei Yisroel. They argued in the encampment—the son of the Israelite woman, and the Israelite man.

verses.he: וּפָרֵשׁ בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת שְׁמָא וְאַרְגֵּז וְאַיְתִיאוּ יָתֵיהּ לְוָת משֶׁה וְשׁוּם אִמֵּיהּ שְׁלֹּמִית בַּת דִּבְרִי לְשִׁבְטָא דְדָן:
verses.en: The Israelite womans son clearly pronounced the Name [of God] and blasphemed [caused anger] and they brought him to Moshe. The name of his mother was Shlomis, daughter of Divri of the tribe of Dan.

verses.he: וְאַסְּרוֹהִי בְּבֵית מַטְּרָא עַד דְּיִתְפָּרַשׁ לְהוֹן עַל גְּזֵרַת מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ:
verses.en: They placed [bound] him in the guardhouse until [his penalty] would be explained to them through the [law of the] word of Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: אַפֵּק יָת דְּאַרְגֵּז לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא וְיִסְמְכוּן כָּל דִּי שְׁמָעוּ יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישֵׁיהּ וְיִרְגְּמוּן יָתֵיהּ כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא:
verses.en: Take the blasphemer [one who has caused anger] beyond the encampment, and all those who heard him shall lay their hands on his head and the entire congregation shall stone him.

verses.he: וְעִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּמַלֵּל לְמֵימָר גְּבַר גְּבַר דִּי יַרְגֵּז קֳדָם אֱלָהֵיהּ וִיקַבֵּל חוֹבֵיהּ:
verses.en: And to Bnei Yisroel you shall speak, saying; Any person who shall blaspheme [cause anger before] his God shall bear [the burden of] his sin.

verses.he: וְדִי פָרֵשׁ שְׁמָא דַיְיָ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל מִרְגַּם יִרְגְּמוּן בֵּיהּ כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא כְּגִיּוֹרָא כְּיַצִּיבָא בְּפָרָשׁוּתֵיהּ שְׁמָא יִתְקְטֵל:
verses.en: Whoever pronounces clearly the Name of Adonoy [and blasphemes] he will surely be put to death. The entire congregation shall surely stone him. The proselyte and native born [settled one] alike when he clearly articulates the Name, shall be put to death.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִקְטוֹל כָּל נַפְשָׁא דַאֲנָשָׁא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל:
verses.en: Any man who kills any human being must surely be put to death.

verses.he: וּדְיִקְטוֹל נְפַשׁ בְּעִירָא יְשַׁלְּמִנַּהּ נַפְשָׁא חֲלַף נַפְשָׁא:
verses.en: Whoever kills an animal shall pay for it, [the compensation of] an animal for an animal.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִתֵּן מוּמָא בְּחַבְרֵיהּ כְּמָא דִי עֲבַד כֵּן יִתְעֲבֶד לֵיהּ:
verses.en: A man who maims his neighbor just as he did, so shall be done to him.

verses.he: תַּבְרָא חֳלַף תַּבְרָא עֵינָא חֳלַף עֵינָא שִׁנָּא חֳלַף שִׁנָּא כְּמָא דִי יִתֵּן מוּמָא בַּאֲנָשָׁא כֵּן יִתְיְהֶב בֵּיהּ:
verses.en: [Compensation for] a broken bone [in exchange] for a broken bone, [compen-sation for] the loss of an eye [in exchange] for the loss of an eye, [compensation for] the loss to a tooth [in exchange] for the loss of a tooth; just as he maimed the man, so shall it be done to him [monetarily].

verses.he: וּדְיִקְטוֹל בְּעִירָא יְשַׁלְּמִנַּהּ וּדְיִקְטוֹל אֲנָשָׁא יִתְקְטֵל:
verses.en: Whoever smites [kills] an animal shall pay for it. Whoever smites [kills] a person shall be put to death.

verses.he: דִּינָא חֲדָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן כְּגִיּוֹרָא כְיַצִּיבָא יְהֵי אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: One rule shall apply for all of you just as it is for the proselyte, so it shall be for the native born [settled one], for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל משֶׁה עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַפִּיקוּ יָת דְּאַרְגֵּז לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא וּרְגָמוּ יָתֵיהּ אַבְנָא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדוּ כְּמָא דִי פַקֵּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה:
verses.en: Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel and they took the blasphemer [one who caused anger], beyond the encampment and they stoned him with a stone. And Bnei Yisroel did just as Adonoy commanded Moshe.
